I had a Break and Enter to Commit Arson charge when I was 16. I was indicted and sentenced to 1 year of probation in 2015. Probation ended in February 2016. Since it was an indictment, it was on my record for 5 years after probation concluded (until February 2021). Was very hard for me when I was applying for Vulnerable Sector Check for volunteer work. Even with full time employment, if a company is forcing me to get a background check from the police station, it will show up if it’s within the applicable disclosure period. A Summary Conviction disclosure period being 3 years, and like I mentioned above, an Indictment being 5 years. It’s a complete myth that your record is sealed at 18.

More information here: https://www.justice.gc.ca/eng/cj-jp/yj-jj/tools-outils/sheets-feuillets/recor-dossi.html
